UX rationale

Familiar enough to trust.
Clear enough to use.

01

Make the route visible

A single vertical path shows entry, stops, and exit as one mental model. Users see where a new stop belongs before they commit.

02

Progressive disclosure

The original two-station flow stays simple. Waypoint controls appear only after “Add a stop,” keeping the default task lightweight.

+Add a stopOptional
03

Prevent route errors

Duplicate stations are flagged before fare review. Reorder and remove controls sit beside each stop, where their effect is obvious.

!
Station already selectedChoose another stop
System extension

Built from the product’s existing language

The concept preserves KMRL’s teal, airy white surfaces, soft elevation, icon-led labels, and generous rounded geometry—then improves hierarchy, feedback, and responsive behavior.
